title: GTA 6 Easter Egg Echoes Classic Tom Cruise Thriller
description: A newly highlighted GTA 6 taxi encounter echoes the classic crime-thriller Collateral starring Tom Cruise and Jamie Foxx.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Cinematic Inspirations in GTA 6

As anticipation for Rockstar Games' upcoming blockbuster continues to build, players and media outlets are constantly on the lookout for hidden details and clever nods within the game's expansive world. According to a recent report by Polygon, a specific taxi encounter in GTA 6 heavily echoes Michael Mann’s classic crime-thriller Collateral, which stars Hollywood icons Tom Cruise and Jamie Foxx.

## Revisiting a Modern Classic

For fans of both cinema and gaming, finding parallels between Rockstar's virtual worlds and celebrated crime films is always a thrilling experience. Collateral, renowned for its tense atmosphere and stellar performances, follows a contract killer and an unsuspecting cab driver navigating a fateful night. The reported taxi encounter in GTA 6 brings that distinct cinematic tension directly into the game's interactive environment.

Players who want to revisit the film or experience it ahead of the game's release can stream it for free on Pluto TV or watch it on Paramount Plus.

## Editor's Take

Rockstar Games has a rich history of embedding cinematic references into their open-world masterpieces. This nod to Collateral in GTA 6 highlights the developers' attention to detail and love for classic crime cinema, promising an even more immersive and culturally rich experience for players exploring the streets.
